description: Window defaults. The host exposes only its own commands plus window dragging (the frame's drag region — core:window:default omits start-dragging, and without it the undecorated window cannot be moved), the notification, updater, process, opener (feedback's browser routes), and clipboard (feedback's screenshot handoff) plugins (the webview owns the taxonomy — notifications, update decisions, feedback composition alike); everything else stays core:default.
